entries.name: App Topbar
entries.description: Global top navigation with logo, search, and user menu.
entries.customization: Height h-14, border-b, bg-background, logo on left, search in center, user menu on right. Use rounded-md for search input, no shadow.

entries.name: App Sidebar
entries.description: Sidebar navigation for app sections.
entries.customization: W-64, bg-muted/50, border-r, p-4. Nav items with icons and labels, active item bg-primary text-primary-foreground. Use rounded-md for item hover.

activeItem.description: ID of the active nav item.

entries.name: Filter Tabs
entries.description: Tabs to filter the conversation list.
entries.customization: Use TabsList with bg-muted, p-1, rounded-md. Active tab bg-background shadow-sm. Text-sm font-medium.

entries.name: Priority Filter
entries.description: Dropdown to filter by priority.
entries.customization: h-9, rounded-md, border-border, bg-background, text-sm. Use SelectTrigger with chevron icon.

entries.name: Status Filter
entries.description: Dropdown to filter by status.
entries.customization: h-9, rounded-md, border-border, bg-background, text-sm. Use SelectTrigger with chevron icon.

entries.name: Sort Select
entries.description: Dropdown to sort the list.
entries.customization: h-9, rounded-md, border-border, bg-background, text-sm. Use SelectTrigger with chevron icon.

entries.name: View Toggle
entries.description: Toggle between list and compact view.
entries.customization: Use ToggleGroup with two ToggleGroupItems, h-9, rounded-md, border-border. Active item bg-muted.

entries.name: Conversation Table
entries.description: Table of conversations with columns for selection, customer, subject, status, priority, assignee, due, and updated.
entries.customization: Header row bg-muted, text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground. Data rows h-12, border-b, hover:bg-muted/50. Use rounded-md on container. Font size text-sm.

conversations.type: {id: string; customerName: string; customerEmail: string; subject: string; status: string; priority: string; assignee: string; due: string; updated: string}[]

entries.name: Bulk Actions
entries.description: Actions for selected conversations.
entries.customization: Use ButtonGroup with buttons h-9, rounded-md, border-border. Primary button bg-primary text-primary-foreground.

entries.name: Conversation Header
entries.description: Header with customer info and subject.
entries.customization: Conversation Header (product-specific): use the 6px radius language (rounded-* family) for corners, #E8570C accent only on the active/primary state with #D24E0B on interactive hover, standard control heights (h-9/h-10) with padding from the spacing scale, and type at "Onest", sans-serif weights with "Space Grotesk", sans-serif reserved for display moments.

entries.name: Message Thread
entries.description: Vertical list of messages in the conversation.
entries.customization: Use MessageScroller with message rows, each with avatar, name, timestamp, and body. Messages bg-muted, rounded-lg, max-w-[75%]. Own messages bg-primary text-primary-foreground.

messages.type: {id: string; sender: string; body: string; timestamp: string; isOwn: boolean}[]

entries.name: Reply Composer
entries.description: Composer for writing a reply.
entries.customization: Use Textarea with min-h-32, rounded-md, border-border, p-3. Attach toolbar with formatting buttons. Send button h-10 bg-primary text-primary-foreground.

entries.name: Detail Panel
entries.description: Panel with conversation metadata and actions.
entries.customization: Detail Panel (product-specific): use the 6px radius language (rounded-* family) for corners, #E8570C accent only on the active/primary state with #D24E0B on interactive hover, standard control heights (h-9/h-10) with padding from the spacing scale, and type at "Onest", sans-serif weights with "Space Grotesk", sans-serif reserved for display moments.

entries.name: Metric Tile
entries.description: Tile displaying a key metric.
entries.customization: Card with p-4, rounded-md, bg-card. Metric value text-3xl font-heading. Label text-sm text-muted-foreground. Trend indicator with icon.

entries.name: Response Time Chart
entries.description: Line chart showing first response time over time.
entries.customization: Use chart with line type, h-64, rounded-md, bg-card. Use primary color for line, muted for grid. Tooltip with bg-popover border-border.

entries.name: Volume Chart
entries.description: Bar chart showing ticket volume by day.
entries.customization: Use chart with bar type, h-64, rounded-md, bg-card. Use primary for created, muted for resolved. Tooltip with bg-popover border-border.

entries.name: Team Leaderboard
entries.description: Table of team members with performance metrics.
entries.customization: Header row bg-muted, text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground. Data rows h-12, border-b, hover:bg-muted/50. Use avatar, name, resolved count, avg response, satisfaction.

members.type: {id: string; name: string; resolved: number; avgResponse: string; satisfaction: number}[]

entries.name: Settings Form
entries.description: Form for editing team settings.
entries.customization: Use Field wrapper with Label, Input, and Description. Inputs h-10, rounded-md, border-border. Use max-w-md for form width.

entries.name: Notification Preferences
entries.description: Checkboxes for notification settings.
entries.customization: Use Checkbox with Label. Rows with h-10, border-b, p-2. Checkbox accent-primary.

entries.name: Team Members
entries.description: Table of team members with roles.
entries.customization: Header row bg-muted, text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground. Data rows h-12, border-b, hover:bg-muted/50. Use avatar, name, email, role select, actions.

members.type: {id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string}[]
